publishabilityEvidence.productionGradeSourceCoverage: Generated recipe composite over publishable Arabic WordNet lexical-semantic resources and CAMeL Morph MSA morphology resources. Arabic WordNet provides lexical entries and canonical lexicon coverage; CAMeL Morph provides MSA morpheme inventory, feature inventory, defaults, and compatibility tables.
publishabilityEvidence.auditedLicense: The exact Arabic WordNet v4.1.0 and CAMeL Morph MSA source rows are approved; required component packages carry package-local license evidence copied from pinned source snapshots.
publishabilityEvidence.declaredScope: Arabic MSA lexicon component composite for Arabic WordNet lexical entries and CAMeL Morph MSA morpheme inventory resources. It does not claim dialectal Arabic lexicon coverage, Classical/Quranic Arabic coverage, corpus frequency coverage, Wiktionary/DBnary definitions, syntax, search, corpus, parallel, or full language-composite coverage.
